summary: Customers can pause a subscription for up to 3 months, once in any 12 month period, from Billing then Plan then Pause subscription.
while_paused: No invoices are created while a subscription is paused, and saved data is kept but the workspace becomes read-only.
resume: A paused subscription resumes automatically at the end of the pause, or earlier when the customer clicks Resume, and billing restarts on the resume date.
not_allowed: Subscriptions with an unpaid invoice or on a trial cannot be paused.
